name: ransom-note
title: Ransom Note
description: A line of text built from mismatched paper scraps, each with its own font, size, skew and pale tint, where the characters spring in from around the page or rock gently in place.
use: A title should feel handmade and a little chaotic, for a playful or zine-like brand.
avoid: It is display type only: every character is its own animated span, so long copy and careful reading suffer.
a11y: The full text is exposed once to screen readers while scraps are hidden, and reduced motion disables both the entrance and the jitter. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: On black, two lines of cut-out letters. The big cream and white headline gives every character its own torn-paper square in a serif, slab or typewriter face; a smaller line below uses pastel scraps of yellow, pink, blue and green. A small outlined pill sits underneath.
behaves: In the assemble mode each scrap springs in from a random offset and slightly wrong angle, then settles into the line one after another. In the jitter mode the letters rock a couple of degrees back and forth forever, each on its own delay.
customise: Pass the text and choose assemble, jitter or none, then set intensity, seed, rotation limit, stagger, and your own font and palette arrays. Letters cannot be styled individually.
weight: light: One spring per character, with an optional light jitter loop that repeats forever.
